'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Israel]] intercepts a [[ballistic missile]] fired from [[Houthi controlled territory of Yemen|Yemen]] in the eighth [[Houthi]] attack since the [[Israeli Defense Force]] resumed the [[Gaza war]]. The Houthis claim to have launched three attacks with [[Drone warfare|drones]], [[missile]]s, and [[Yemeni Navy|naval forces]] against the [[aircraft carrier]] {{USS|Harry S. Truman|}} in the past 24 hours. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/houthi-missile-triggers-sirens-in-central-israel-is-downed-en-route/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Myanmar earthquake]]
**[[List of populated places affected by the 2025 Myanmar earthquake#Structures and infrastructure|Structures and infrastructure affected by the 2025 Myanmar earthquake]]
***The count of the total amount of destroyed ancient [[pagoda]]s and religious buildings in [[Myanmar]] rises to 61, including the previously unreported [[Four-Storied Monastery]] in [[Inwa]], [[Mandalay Region]]. [https://npnewsmm.com/news/67e8f0ca7bc0d4471b7630bd (NP)]
*[[Severe weather]] and [[tornadoes]] break out in the areas between south [[Indiana]] and north east [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/30/weather/tornado-storms-missouri-illinois.html (''The New York Times'')]
*A bus lost control and crashed in [[Katsina State]], [[Nigeria]], killing nine and injuring 11. [https://guardian.ng/news/nigeria/metro/nine-killed-in-katsina-crash-on-malumfashi-kafur-road/ (The Guardian)]
*Four people are killed after two cars collide on PJ Patterson Highway, [[Jamaica]]. [https://www.stvincenttimes.com/jamaica-four-killed-crash-pj-patterson-highway/ (St Vincent Times)]
*Three children are killed and three other people are injured after a tree hits their vehicle near [[Kalamazoo, Michigan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/severe-weather-great-lakes-michigan-tennessee-southeast-7b35717298545424f50c9ca829ea0718 (AP)]
*A 7.0 [[Richter scale|M{{sub|w}}]] earthquake strikes near the island country of [[Tonga]] with a 6.1 M{{sub|w}} [[aftershock]]. A [[tsunami]] warning is issued and later lifted. [https://apnews.com/article/tonga-earthquake-tsunami-warning-pacific-island-0bcaab5e5e83156846a65ed46556391e (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[President of Iran|Iranian president]] [[Masoud Pezeshkian]] says that [[Iran]] will not have direct negotiations with the U.S. on its [[Nuclear program of Iran|nuclear program]], but is open for indirect talks to rebuild trust, after [[U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] threatened "bombing" if Iran does not agree to a new nuclear deal. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/3/30/iran-rejects-direct-nuclear-talks-with-trump-open-to-indirect-negotiations (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/trump-says-there-will-be-bombing-if-iran-does-not-make-nuclear-deal-2025-03-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[German space programme]]
**The uncrewed [[Germany|German]]-built [[Isar Aerospace Spectrum|Spectrum]] [[Launch vehicle|orbital rocket]] is launched in [[Andøya]], [[Norway]], becoming the first orbital rocket to launch from [[Continental Europe|mainland Europe]]. The rocket stays in the air for just over half a minute before striking the ground and exploding. [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2025/mar/30/first-orbital-rocket-launched-europe-crashes-launch-spectrum (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.vg.no/nyheter/i/eM4vnO/andoeya-kan-bli-vitne-til-historisk-rakettoppskyting-soendag (VG)]
